snippet.title: Everafter Falls – Launch Trailer –  Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Everafter Falls is available now on the Nintendo Switch! Rediscover the simple life. Farm, fish, forge and fight to restore the peace in an all-new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a helpful pet, automated drones, resourceful pixies, a card-eating progression system, and dangerous dungeons to delve into! 
 
https://ninten.do/6050Y2DUo
